name: gusanito
description: Online artillery for 2 to 6 players with destructible terrain, wind and gravity wells. Plays on phones.

scripts.build: bun build src/client/main.ts --outdir dist --minify --sourcemap=linked --target browser && cp public/* dist/ && cp install.sh dist/
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun test test/e2e --timeout 60000
scripts.og-card: bun run build && bun run scripts/og-card.ts
